laws.title: No secrets in the repository
laws.rationale: A committed secret is a leaked secret; enforcement at the keystroke is the only reliable guard.
laws.prose: Never write a .env file into the repository. Secrets live in the environment, not in version control.

laws.title: Local-first is non-negotiable
laws.rationale: speclaw runs entirely on the user's machine; every new dependency must be justified in the PR.
laws.prose: Justify any new dependency in the PR: it must not break 'runs offline with no API keys'.

laws.title: Protect the templates
laws.rationale: Assets under src/modules/*/assets/** are product output; the build must copy them and the {{placeholder}} contracts must stay intact.
laws.prose: Assets under src/modules/*/assets/** are product output — keep the {{placeholder}} and speclaw-init contracts intact, and let the build copy them (never hand-copy into dist/).

laws.title: Keep attribution honest
laws.rationale: Compass reimplements CodeGraph and Lawbook reimplements OpenSpec (both MIT); ATTRIBUTION.md must stay accurate.
laws.prose: Keep ATTRIBUTION.md accurate as the Compass and Lawbook modules evolve.

laws.title: shared stays the innermost layer
laws.rationale: shared/ must not import modules/ or cli/, or the layering law is inverted.
laws.prose: src/shared must not import from src/modules or src/cli.

laws.title: Compass does not import foundation
laws.rationale: foundation already imports compass; the reverse would be a module cycle.
laws.prose: src/modules/compass must not import from src/modules/foundation.

laws.title: No circular module dependencies
laws.rationale: Modules may reuse another module's exported helper, but there are no circular dependencies.
laws.prose: There are no circular dependencies between modules.
